name: 01_upstairs_door
origin: Michel's example (2026-10-06): a one-week assignment upstairs; the alarm warning must outlive the project

memories.title: UI Brand Revamp
memories.body: One-week project helping the team upstairs with a brand revamp.

memories.title: Location of the upstairs team
memories.body: Third floor, east wing, second door on the left.

memories.title: Door alarm warning
memories.body: Every door in the building alarms if a code is entered wrong twice in a row.

steps.note: During the week, one pull brings up the whole structure.
Pulling the warning also brings its live context.
After the project, the path information has sunk.
The warning comes up alone, without its stale baggage.
A month later the warning is still available.
